scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
scripts.logs: docker compose logs -f proxy frontend backend
scripts.analytics:up: docker compose --profile analytics up -d postgres airflow dbt
scripts.analytics:down: docker compose --profile analytics stop dbt airflow postgres
scripts.analytics:logs: docker compose --profile analytics logs -f postgres airflow
scripts.analytics:dbt:shell: docker compose --profile analytics run --rm dbt bash
scripts.test:backend:install: cd backend && python3 -m venv --clear .venv && ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
